notes.title: Major bug fix
notes.notes:
Important Announcement: Update Released for Game Bugs Fix!

Dear Players,

We are constantly working to provide you with a better gaming experience. However, we have released a new update to address some of the issues encountered by some players. This update includes various fixes that will enhance the stability and optimize the performance of the game.

Update Notes:

-General performance of the game has been improved.
-Bug fixes and stability enhancements have been implemented.
-Graphical glitches occurring in specific scenarios have been rectified.
-Issues with in-game interactions have been resolved.
-Installing this update will ensure smoother and more seamless gameplay. You can expect the update to initiate automatically or you can manually check for it from your Steam client.

We value all kinds of feedback to help us enhance your gaming experience. If you encounter any issues with the game, please report them to us at [support@yokothegame.com] or through the Steam Community Forums. As a team, we will work to resolve any issues as quickly as possible.

Thank you and happy gaming!
